subject: POC commitment: milestones, success slate, and circuit-breakers (PicoHealth)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@picohealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: PicoHealth POC scope & next steps

Hi Elena — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed POC plan attached. Please review and confirm changes by EOD Monday so we can lock dates.

High-level goal
- Validate Redwood inference can reduce triage latency for clinical notes tagging from 14s -> <3s end-to-end, with precision >= 92% on your labeled set.

Success criteria (draft)
- Latency: 95th percentile <3s for 1–2 concurrent requests per user profile.
- Quality: weighted F1 >= 0.92 on the provided holdout; false positive rate <6% on sensitive tag set.
- Throughput: baseline throughput of 400 req/min sustained for 30m during a synthetic load test.
- Integration: S3 ingestion + SSO complete; sample pipeline processes first 1k records within 48h of data handoff.

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Finalize scope, sign MSA addendum (if needed), share data sample and schema.
- Week 1: Ingest sample data, baseline runs, initial metric collection.
- Week 2: Model/quantization tuning, batching profiles, run acceptance tests.
- Week 3: Acceptance run and handoff to PicoHealth for evaluation; decision point for production pilot.

Ownership
- Redwood PM: Jonas Weber (me) — engagement lead and escalation.
- Redwood Dev lead: Stephanie Nguyen — ingestion + runtime tuning + hotfix lead.
- PicoHealth Eng: Elena Morales — data handoff, evaluation sign-off.
- Procurement contact: Marcus Lee (procurement@picohealth.com) — contract/PO.

Risks & immediate mitigations
- Risk: Missing PII flags in sample -> false positives in classification.
  Mitigation: We will run a quick PII detection pre-pass (local rule-based) and map fields to your schema; fallback to conservative suppression for flagged fields.
- Risk: SOC2 evidence needed before any data onboarding.
  Mitigation: attaching SOC2 excerpt and low-risk sandbox option (no persistent storage).
- Circuit-breaker (pre-agreed): If false positive rate on sensitive tags >10% during baseline, we will halt automated writes and switch to read-only evaluation mode until mitigation patch is applied.

Attachments:
- pico_poc_plan_v1.xlsx (POC milestone spreadsheet)
- data_sample_schema.json (sample schema + required fields)

Asks for PicoHealth
- Confirm dataset delivery method (S3 bucket + IAM user) and expected delivery date.
- Confirm procurement next steps (PO timeline).
- Confirm SOC2 excerpt suffices for sandbox ingestion or list additional compliance items.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Morales <elena@picohealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lee <mlee@picohealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: PicoHealth POC scope & next steps

Thanks for the thorough recap, Jonas — this matches our notes. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: Marcus (copied) will need a short statement of work + estimated spend to open a PO. We typically sign POs within 2–3 weeks.
- Security: SOC2 excerpt looks good, but our security team will ask for an ingestion-only sandbox with logging disabled for persistent storage. Can you confirm the sandbox option is available?
- Data: We will deliver a 2k-row sample by Tue 8/17 (we're clearing PII flags first). If the PII flags are missing on some records there may be a short delay.

I also want to confirm the acceptance window: when you say "acceptance run" in Week 3, do you mean a 48-hour window for our team to validate results and sign-off? That works for us if we have the baseline metrics and runbook beforehand.

One more ask: can you include an explicit escalation contact for production-impacting issues (on-call engineer or dev lead)? We prefer a direct phone contact for Sev-1.

Elena Morales
Director, Engineering — Data Platform
PicoHealth
elena@picohealth.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@picohealth.com>, Marcus Lee <mlee@picohealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: PicoHealth POC — owners, mitigations, and circuit-breakers (follow-up)

Team — following Elena's reply, I want to lock who owns what and the escalation path if we hit a blocker. Keeping it short.

Confirmed owners
- Stephanie: dev lead and hotfix SLA owner (24h target to triage / 72h for production fix where applicable). Also point person for the PII detection pre-pass.
- Aditya: commercial/contract owner — handle SOW and PO estimates; coordinate terms with Marcus.
- Jonas: engagement lead and primary escalation for execs.

Immediate actions (by Mon EOD)
1) Stephanie: produce a short runbook for the sandbox ingestion flow + a mini hotfix playbook covering PII mislabeling and model rollback. Attach to Drive link.
2) Aditya: prepare a draft SOW and estimated spend for Marcus; estimate to include 3 weeks of POC engineering + 1 week of handover and acceptance testing.
3) Jonas: confirm SSO/S3 access pattern and share the 48h acceptance checklist with Elena.

Circuit-breaker policy (proposal)
- Trigger: baseline evaluation shows sensitive-tag false positive rate >10% OR any data exfil risk detected.
- Immediate action: switch to read-only evaluation, pause automated downstream writes, notify PicoHealth and schedule hotfix run.
- Escalation path: Stephanie -> Jonas -> Redwood on-call (ENG on-call: +1-650-555-0911) -> CTO if unresolved at 72h.

Notes on mitigations
- Short-term: rule-based PII pre-pass + conservative suppression flags.
- Medium-term: model score threshold tuning + retraining candidate if mislabeling concentrated in a specific cluster.

Attachments / links:
- Hotfix runbook to prepare: hotfix_runbook.md (will upload)
- Jira: SUP-1127 (pre-created ticket for PII-mapping work)

I'll own coordinating the runbook with Stephanie. Stephanie — can you confirm an ETA for the runbook?

Jonas

From: Elena Morales <elena@picohealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lee <mlee@picohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: PicoHealth POC scope & next steps

Forwarded message:
> From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
> Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
> Subject: Post-call recap: PicoHealth POC scope & next steps

Quick update from our side — we've finished prepping the sample but found an inconsistent PII flag across a subset (about 150 rows). That means the dataset we're planning to hand over will arrive with mixed flags unless we do additional cleanup. Given our compliance requirements we can't ship the set until flags are reconciled.

This will likely push our delivery to Thu 8/19 or Fri 8/20. If that timeline changes I'll inform you immediately. We are prepared to provide a smaller (<500 row) fully-flagged sample earlier if it helps unblock your baseline runs.

We appreciate the circuit-breaker language. Two asks:
- Please confirm whether the sandbox ingest option truly prevents any persistent storage on Redwood's side (we need an audit statement).
- Provide the direct escalation number for a Sev-1 (we need a phone contact).

Elena

---
Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@picohealth.com>

Elena — acknowledging. We'll accept the smaller fully-flagged sample ASAP; Stephanie will kick off the PII pre-pass and ping you when it's ready.

Escalation (contact)
- Stephanie Nguyen (dev lead, hotfix owner): stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, +1 (415) 555-0188
- Redwood on-call (for Sev-1 after hours): +1-650-555-0911

Sandbox audit statement
- Redwood confirms sandbox ingestion is transient: data is processed in RAM and ephemeral worker storage; no objects are persisted to durable buckets in the sandbox flow. We will provide a short signed attestation doc for procurement.

Thanks — will accept the smaller sample if you can send it earlier.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
